sources.title: OpenAI Accuses Moonshot AI of 16,000 Data Extraction Attempts
sources.snippet: The AI model data extraction activity began on July 1 at low volume but spiked dramatically on July 24 and 25, when OpenAI detected approximately 16,000 requests from more than 4,000 users 2 2 OpenAI subsequently identified related activity across more than 15,000 users before fully shutting down the coordinated campaign by July 28.
